1. Authorization & Token


1. Access Token refresh returns AUTH_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED after the App goes Online

Problem Calling /auth/token/refresh to refresh the Access Token returns AUTH_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED, or after the App goes Online the OAuth authorization link stops working and reports "temporary failure of the server".

Common characteristics: the App status has changed from Testing to Online; the App category is usually ERP System / a commercial-type App.

Solution

Root cause After the App goes Online, the authorization strategy automatically switches to ASA (Allow Subscribers to Authorize, subscription-based authorization). In this mode the Token validity is bound to the seller's subscription cycle (up to 18 months) and can no longer be refreshed via/auth/token/refresh; at the same time the direct OAuth authorization link becomes invalid, and the seller must subscribe through the Service Marketplace before authorizing.

Steps

  1. Publish the App to the Lazada Service Marketplace (if it is not yet published, "temporary failure of the server" will appear).
  2. After the seller subscribes and authorizes through the Service Marketplace, obtain the Token again.
  3. No Token refresh is needed within the subscription period; after the subscription expires, the seller re-subscribes and obtains a new Token.
Reference: Lazada Open Platform - Service Market Entry Operation Guidelines (Service Marketplace onboarding and publishing operation guide).



2. Refresh Token valid for only 1 day, inconsistent with the documented 180 days

Problem The obtained Refresh Token is valid for only 1 day, which does not match the 180 days stated in the documentation.

Solution

Root cause

  1. When the App is in Testing status, both the Access Token and Refresh Token have a short validity (about 1 day), intended for testing and integration.
  2. When the App is in Online status, the Access Token is valid for 30 days and the Refresh Token for 180 days.

Steps

  1. Check the App Status in the App console.
  2. If it is Testing, click "Apply Online" to submit for go-live after integration is complete.
  3. Once the App becomes Online, run the authorization flow again to obtain long-validity Tokens.


3. Seller already whitelisted but OAuth authorization still reports "short code invalid"

Problem The seller has been added to the App's Authorized Seller Whitelist, but OAuth authorization still reports The specified seller short code is invalid, or redirects to a blank page / a login loop.

Solution

Root cause Seller In-House type Apps currently support per-site authorization only. If the authorization page is already logged in with another site or another seller account by default, it will be blocked directly and report that the short code is invalid.

Steps

  1. Open the authorization page → click "Switch" to enter the Seller Center of the currently logged-in seller.
  2. Log out from the bottom-right corner of Seller Center.
  3. Return to the authorization page and refresh, then select the target site (e.g., MY / TH / VN).
  4. Click "Use Seller Login" and enter the seller account credentials for the corresponding site.
  5. After logging in, return to the authorization page and click "Authorize" to complete authorization.
Tip: If you forget the password, click "Reset password" on the Seller Center login page of the corresponding site.



4. Authorization page (OAuth redirect stage) reports a "Missing parameter" error

Problem During seller authorization, after logging into Seller Center the authorization page reports a Missing parameter error and authorization cannot be completed.

Solution

Root cause An intermittent issue that can occur on the first authorization for each site.

Steps

  1. Make sure to use the Google Chrome browser.
  2. Ask the seller not to close the current browser window, and re-open the authorization link auth.lazada.com/... in the same window to run through the authorization flow again.
  3. If the error persists, check the authorization entry URL generated by the ISV: confirm the domain is auth.lazada.com, and that client_id, response_type=code, redirect_uri, and state are all complete and non-empty, and that redirect_uri exactly matches the callback URL configured in the App backend.



2. Permissions & API Groups


5. IM / Chat APIs return InsufficientPermission; the IM permission group cannot be found

Problem Calling IM / messaging APIs (such as /im/session/list, /im/message/send) returns InsufficientPermission, or the "Instant Messaging API" group cannot be found under API Permission Group in the App console.

Solution

Root cause IM/Chat Open API permission is not granted through the regular API permission application process; it is held only by IM-type Apps (ERP IM Chat / In-house IM Chat). Apps in other categories such as ERP System cannot add this permission group.

Steps

  1. Re-apply in the Developer Center for the In-house IM Chat (own store) or ERP IM Chat (service provider / multi-seller) category.
  2. Category applications are usually approved within 1 business day.
  3. Create the application using the new App's AppKey and have the seller re-authorize (authorization is bound to the AppKey; the old App's Token cannot be reused).
  4. Only 1 ERP System App is allowed per account; if the quota is used up, apply through a new account.


6. No permission for Promotion / Advertising / Reverse Order and similar APIs

Problem Calling promotion / advertising / reverse order and similar APIs returns App does not have permission to call this API.

Solution

Root cause The permission group that this API belongs to has not been enabled. Most API groups can be self-applied in the App console; some sensitive groups require a matching category.

Steps

  1. Open the Developer Console → target App → API Permission → Apply Permission Group.
  2. Check the target groups (such as Promotion, Advertising, Reverse Order, etc.) and submit the application.
  3. If the group cannot be found in the list, the current App category does not support it; you need to re-apply for a matching-category App as with the IM category.
  4. After approval, the seller must re-authorize for the token to carry the new permissions (Token permission points are snapshotted at authorization time; later additions do not take effect automatically).


7. Messages not pushed after first-time IM Webhook configuration

Problem After integrating the IM Webhook for the first time, seller send/receive messages do not trigger push events.

Solution

Root cause After the first-time IM Webhook configuration there is a 24-hour cache refresh period, during which pushes are not actually delivered.

Steps

  1. Keep the Webhook callback configuration unchanged and wait 24 hours.
  2. After 24 hours, ask the seller to deauthorize → re-authorize.
  3. Trigger a buyer message again, and the push will be received normally.


3. API Rate Limiting


8. Rate limit rules, error codes, and retry strategy (ApiCallLimit / E1002, etc.)

Problem APIs return ApiCallLimit / AppApiCallLimit / SellerCallLimit / E1002, or you want to understand the QPS and retry strategy of the Lazada Open Platform.

Solution

Rate limit rules

  1. QPS: shared globally at the API level; the per-second quota for the same API is shared by all developers, and once triggered there is a short ban of about 1 second; increases cannot be applied for.
  2. Daily Call Limit: calculated per AppKey. Testing status: 10,000 calls/day; Online status: 10,000,000 calls/day. Exceeding the limit generally results in a ban of about 14 hours.

Common error codes

Error code

Meaning

ApiCallLimit

API-level global rate limit

AppApiCallLimit

App-level rate limit (longer ban time)

E1002

Backend rate limit; can be treated as a temporary error

SellerCallLimit

Triggered only by test accounts; test account QPS is about 4, shared resources

Recommended retry strategy

  1. On rate limiting or 5xx errors, retry with exponential backoff (1s → 2s → 4s → 8s …).
  2. Avoid dense calls during peak periods such as big promotions and on-the-hour marks; spread requests evenly.
  3. In production, always use an Online-status AppKey to avoid mistakenly using the test quota.


9. APIs occasionally return 500 / 501 / ServiceTimeout

Problem Occasionally returns 500 / 501 / ServiceTimeout, or the detail is SYSTEM_ERROR.

Solution

Root cause 500 / 501 / ServiceTimeout are transient server-side errors, usually related to backend network issues, downstream dependency jitter, or overlapping rate limiting — not signature or parameter problems.

Steps

  1. Single error → retry 2-3 times with exponential backoff.
  2. Frequent, persistent occurrences → submit a ticket with:
  3. Request ID (the request_id field in the response)
  4. The exact call time (to the second) and site
  5. The complete request parameters and response payload (with sensitive values removed)
  6. Note the distinction from E501 (a business error): E501 is a generic "Update failed"; the specific reason is in the response detail, and it is not a system error.



4. Products & Inventory


10. /product/stock/sellable/update returns 4173 (RedMart does not allow dropshipping)

Problem Calling /product/stock/sellable/update to update inventory returns 4173 - Dropshipping stock is not allowed for RedMart.

Solution

Root cause RedMart-category products do not go through the normal dropshipping inventory channel; the RSS (RedMart Seller Service) inventory API must be used.

Steps

  1. Determine whether the SKU carries a RedMart RPC.
  2. Regular Lazada SKU: continue calling /product/stock/sellable/update.
  3. RedMart SKU: use /rss/stockLot/update (RssUpdateStockLot) instead.
  4. Note: the RSS API is open only to RedMart-category Apps; if not enabled, apply for the corresponding category first.


11. Inventory update E501, or Seller Center backend quantity inconsistent with the pushed value

Problem Calling /product/stock/sellable/update returns E501 (No data to update), or the Seller Center backend inventory display is inconsistent with the pushed value (e.g., there is still stock remaining after pushing 0).

Solution

Root cause There are two common cases:

  1. A single-warehouse seller used the multi-warehouse (MultiWarehouseInventories) format, and the API reports E501.
  2. A multi-warehouse seller updated only one of the warehouses, while Seller Center shows the total across all warehouses.

Steps

  1. Call /rc/warehouse/get to get all warehouses for the seller.
  2. If the response contains only the customerreturn / dropshipping warehouses → single-warehouse seller; use the single-warehouse format(SKU-level SellableQuantity) and do not pass MultiWarehouseInventories.
  3. If multi-warehouse → update inventory for each warehouse separately.
  4. Reminder: the quantity passed to /product/stock/sellable/update is the target sellable inventory value (an absolute value that directly overwrites); the quantity passed to /product/stock/sellable/adjust is a delta (an increment added to or subtracted from the current inventory). Under the hood, update executes changes in an incremental manner, so do not send multiple concurrent update requests for the same SKU; otherwise a race condition may cause inventory to be stacked incorrectly. Serial updates are recommended.


12. /product/update returns 4112 Duplicate Attribute or E305 Parameter Invalid

Problem Calling /product/update returns 4112 - Duplicate Attribute or E305 - Parameter Invalid, but no obvious duplication is found when checking the parameters.

Solution

Root cause Common triggers:

  1. The same attribute appears in multiple places in the payload (e.g., passed in both attributes and SKU-level attributes).
  2. Inconsistent category sale props (different SKUs under the same product use different spec keys such as color and color_family).
  3. Submitting fields that are deprecated / unsupported for the category.

Steps

  1. Use /category/attributes/get to pull the attribute list for the target category_id and verify field names and whether they are supported.
  2. The saleProp of all SKUs under the same SPU must be unified (e.g., all use color, or all use color_family).
  3. Avoid having the same-named attribute appear in both attributes and skus.attributes.
  4. Retry after fixing; if it still fails, submit a ticket with the Request ID and the complete payload.



13. /product/global/create shows success but the product cannot be found in the backend or via /products/get

Problem Calling the /product/global/create cross-border listing API returns success, but the product cannot be found in Seller Center or via /products/get.

Solution

Root cause Cross-border listing is an asynchronous process: a successful return from /product/global/create only means the listing was submittedsuccessfully; it still needs to be synchronized and landed on each site.

Steps

  1. Call /product/global/status/get to query the synchronization status of each site.
  2. Only sites that synchronized successfully will return an item_id.
  3. Query the product in the Seller Center of the corresponding target site(e.g., if published only to TH, it naturally cannot be found in the MY backend).
  4. If a site fails to synchronize, the response will contain the specific error; correct it as indicated and retry.



14. Product / inventory APIs return SELLER_NOT_PERMITTED (E501 / E0501)

Problem Calling /product/update or an inventory update API returns SELLER_NOT_PERMITTED (E501/E0501).

Solution

Root cause This error is a seller-side issue, unrelated to the integration implementation. It is usually caused by the seller's store information not having completed review, the store being restricted, or missing qualifications.

Steps

  1. Ask the seller to log into Seller Center and check whether the store profile / qualifications have completed review.
  2. For a new store, wait for the store information review to pass.
  3. Once the review passes, the API recovers automatically; no changes to the integration code are needed.
  4. If the seller reports that the review has passed but the error persists, submit a ticket with the Request ID.



5. Orders & Buyer Information


15. Order API name / address / phone masked with *** (Buyer Information Encryption policy)

Problem Since July 2026, even after passing DataMoat approval, the shipping / billing address, name, and phone returned by /order/get and /orders/getare still masked with *** asterisks and cannot be used for shipping or invoicing.

Solution

Policy note Since 2026-07, the Lazada Open Platform has been rolling out the "Encryption of Buyer Information for Orders" policy in batches, masking/encrypting the name, address, and phone. This is a platform-level policy change, unrelated to App authorization configuration.

Recommendations

  1. For regular order fulfillment: rely on the platform shipping-label API(/order/package/document/get, etc.); the label itself contains complete recipient information and can be used for printing and shipping.
  2. For scenarios needing e-invoicing / customer-service follow-up: it is recommended that the seller manually view the complete information in Seller Center and provide it offline.
  3. Currently, no API, permission, or application process can restore the full plaintext address. Only a few specific scenarios (such as government-certified e-invoice service providers) may apply through the DataMoat sensitive-data review, but the review scope is limited.
  4. Reference announcement: Important - Encryption of Buyer Information for Orders (published 2026-05-28, gradually covering all order query requests from 2026-07-01).


16. Order paid amount does not match the promotion details in Seller Center

Problem The order paid amount (paid_price / shipping_amount) does not match the promotion details seen in the seller backend.

Solution

Note

  1. The buyer's paid amount = paid_price + shipping_amount, and all price fields are tax-inclusive.
  2. Itemized breakdowns of coupons / platform subsidies / apportionment are not provided through the Open API, so the API cannot fully reproduce the line-item amounts on the Seller Center settlement page.

Recommendations

  1. For reconciliation, use the API aggregate basis (paid_price + shipping_amount).
  2. When you need to see itemized discounts, rounding apportionment, and other details, contact Seller Support with the complete Order ID to request a manual apportionment breakdown.
  3. Settlement-type discrepancies belong to Seller Center business rules, not Open API issues.



17. Missing orders in order queries, or Webhook events not pushed

Problem The order list API cannot find some orders after a certain point in time, or buyer messages are visible in Seller Center but the Webhook did not push them.

Solution

Troubleshooting steps

1. Check whether the query window covers the order creation time, and confirm you are using the site's latest time zone.

2. For Webhooks not pushing:

  1. Confirm the subscribed event type is correct (order-type / IM-type).
  2. There is a 24-hour cache period after the first subscription.
  3. The Webhook callback must return HTTP 200 within 500ms.
  4. The certificate must be OV/EV (DV is not accepted).


18. /order/package/document/get shipping label lacks item details, inconsistent with the backend template

Problem The label generated by the /order/package/document/get label API is missing detail fields, or is inconsistent with the template printed from Seller Center.

Solution

Note The API returns the standard label template; Seller Center prints an "enhanced template" that can include item detail lines and other information. The enhanced template is currently not supported on the API side.

Recommendations

  1. If you must print a label with details, have the seller print it directly within Seller Center.
  2. If using the API label, you can combine /order/items/get to fetch item details separately and merge them for display in your own system.
  3. There is currently no timetable on the platform side for introducing the enhanced template into the API.


6. Service Marketplace / Qualifications


19. The category dropdown on the service publishing page shows "No data"

Problem When publishing a commercial-type App to the Service Marketplace, no data is available in the dropdown list and the service category cannot be selected.

Solution

Steps

Publishing a service requires the qualification and the application category to correspond one-to-one. An empty dropdown is usually due to the following reasons; check them in order:

  1. Qualification category mismatch: before publishing, you must complete the qualification for the corresponding category. The category of an approved qualification must match the current application's App category. Check the "Apply for the new qualification" entry to see whether there is a qualification option corresponding to the current application category; if so, submit the application. Common correspondences:
  2. IM / customer-service type → Lazada Customer Service Operation Service
  3. Accounting / finance-and-tax type → Lazada Financial Service (software type requires Financial Service (Software))
  4. ERP / order type → ERP System related qualification
  5. Bank card not bound: a payout bank card must be bound before publishing a service; confirm it has been bound successfully.
  6. Application not online: the service publishing page lists only applications that have passed the go-live review (status Online).

If all of the above are confirmed correct but there is still no data, provide a screenshot of the qualification page and submit a ticket to contact the Open Platform support team for verification.

Reference: Lazada Open Platform - Service Market Entry Operation Guidelines (Service Marketplace onboarding operation guide, including qualification application and service publishing process).



20. Requesting to change partner type / modify company information

Problem You want to change from Personal Self-Developed or Enterprise Self-Developed type to Enterprise Commercial, or you want to modify the certified company name / email / phone number.

Solution

Important rules

  1. Partner Type (Self-Developed / Commercial) cannot be changed once registered.
  2. A single corporate entity can own multiple developer accounts.
  3. The phone number and email of a new account must be brand new and never registered on any Lazada platform.

Paths

  1. If a self-developed type needs to become a Service Provider / convert to a commercial type → register an Enterprise Commercial account with a brand-new email/phone number and re-create the App.
  2. The In-house App under the old account can coexist with the Commercial App under the new account without affecting each other.
  3. To modify company information → edit it in the "Basic Information" section of the workbench, submit for approval, and wait for it to pass.
  4. To modify the login email → it cannot be changed by yourself; submit a ticket to request the change.


21. Service Marketplace subscription reports "cumulative order period cannot exceed 18 months"

Problem Service Marketplace subscription / trial records prevent a new App from being installed (with the message "cumulative order period cannot exceed 18 months").

Solution

Note The Service Marketplace subscription cap is 18 consecutive months; historical subscription records are ledger records and cannot be deleted, but you can deactivate a subscription on the "My Service" page.

Steps

  1. The seller goes to Seller Center → My Service, finds the target App, and cancels the current subscription.
  2. If the cumulative period has reached 18 months, wait for some historical subscriptions to expire before re-subscribing.
  3. When borrowing a test account, note that historical subscriptions cannot be cleared; if you need a clean environment, apply for a separate test account.


7. Sensitive Data / DataMoat


22. DataMoat review completed but API responses are still masked

Problem The DataMoat "Access to Sensitive Data" review is completed (Step 5 shows Completed), but the buyer information returned by the API is still masked.

Solution

Note Passing the DataMoat review only means you are qualified to access sensitive data; for it to actually take effect, the following conditions are also required:

  1. The approved scope matches the requested fields.
  2. The seller consented to the corresponding permission points at authorization time.
  3. When combined with the Buyer Information Encryption policy effective 2026-07, only specific fields can be decrypted.

Steps

  1. First contact the App's corresponding KAM / business contact to confirm whether the DataMoat review scope covers the fields you need.
  2. Have the authorized seller deauthorize and then re-authorize so the Token carries the new permission points.
  3. If the review scope does not cover them, re-submit the DataMoat application and attach the complete flow chart + NDA in Question 10.
  4. Special note: even after the review passes, under the encryption policy some fields (such as recipient name/phone/address) still cannot be pulled via the API (only self-delivery orders are exceptions).


23. DataMoat application rejected, or the penetration test link is judged "not accessible"

Problem The DataMoat application is rejected (Rejection) and the specific rejection reason cannot be seen in the console; or the Step 3.2 penetration test link is judged "not accessible".

Solution

Steps

a. Common rejection reasons:

  1. Incomplete materials (missing NDA / missing flow chart / data storage location not described).
  2. The described system data flow does not match reality.
  3. The penetration test login link requires a VPN / whitelist, or returns a non-2xx response.

b. When submitting a ticket, attach:

  1. Project ID / AppKey
  2. A screenshot of the rejection page
  3. The complete flow chart (inter-system data flow diagram)
  4. Server access logs from within the last 48 hours (to prove the test link is reachable)

C. The NDA can be uploaded together with the flow chart in Question 10 of the DataMoat form, or submitted as a ticket attachment.

d. Re-submit after making changes; the review cycle is usually 5-10 business days.



8. Sandbox / Test Accounts


24. Sandbox / borrowed test account orders report "sold out" or "Traffic is hot"

Problem Using a platform-borrowed test account to create an Order Test Case, the product is clearly on sale but reports "sold out" or "Traffic is hot".

Solution

Troubleshooting steps

1) In the test environment, a product must have inventory in every warehouse and every SKU to be orderable. Call /rc/warehouse/get to view all warehouses of the store, replenish inventory one by one, and then place the order.

2) Test accounts have a QPS of about 4 and are a shared resource; when "Traffic is hot" appears, wait a few seconds and retry.

3) DBS/SOF borrowed accounts commonly require additional whitelisting; if "sold out" is reported repeatedly, submit a ticket with: the test account short code, the product ID, and the time.

4) For production validation, always use a formal Online-status AppKey; test accounts have lower QPS and Daily Call Limit.


25. Developer account / App cancellation and test account return

Problem You want to delete / cancel a developer account or App, or you want to reclaim a borrowed test account.

Solution

Paths

a. Developer account / App cancellation is a manual review process; submit a ticket with:

  1. The account email / entity name
  2. The list of AppKeys to be cancelled
  3. The reason for cancellation (e.g., business shutdown / entity merger, etc.)

b. The platform will check whether the account has unsettled orders, subscriptions, or seller authorizations, and process it after clearing them one by one.

c. For borrowed test accounts, submit a return request through the original application entry.


9. General


26. APIs return IncompleteSignature / IllegalAccessToken

Problem Returns IncompleteSignature / IllegalAccessToken; signature or Token verification failed.

Solution

Troubleshooting steps

a. Clock synchronization: ensure the calling machine's deviation from NTP time is < 3 minutes.

b. Signature algorithm: use HMAC-SHA256, concatenate key+value in lexicographical order of parameter names, and add the API path prefix.

c. Parameter completeness: include all non-empty business parameters and system parameters (app_key / timestamp / sign_method / access_token, etc.) before signing; the only thing not included in the signature is sign itself.

d. Token: confirm the access_token has not expired and belongs to the target site; Tokens are not interchangeable across sites.

e. Encode Chinese / special characters in UTF-8 before signing.

f. If using an SDK: upgrade to the latest version first; for a self-implemented signature, compare field by field against the official documentation examples.


27. Are operational data APIs such as Sponsored Max Ads / Lazada Coins available?

Problem You want to obtain platform operational data such as Sponsored Max Ads and Lazada Coins coupons via API.

Solution

Note The following capabilities are not yet available through the Open API:

  1. Sponsored Max Ads / on-site ad delivery details
  2. Lazada Coins usage records and discount apportionment
  3. Settlement amount line items, platform subsidy apportionment
  4. Complete buyer PII (name / phone / address / tax ID)

Recommendations

  1. Advertising data should be exported by the seller in the Seller Center backend / queried using the ad backend account.
  2. Financial line-item discrepancies go through Seller Support for manual reconciliation.
  3. If it is a strong business need, you can submit an "API Request" type ticket for the platform to evaluate and include in planning.
  4. Regularly follow the Open Platform Announcement and new-version Release Notes.


28. What information should be prepared when submitting a ticket for faster troubleshooting

Problem When you encounter a difficult problem and need to submit a ticket, what information should be prepared for faster troubleshooting?

Solution

Minimum required information checklist

  1. AppKey and App type (In-house / ERP, etc.)
  2. Seller Short Code and seller type (local / Cross-border) (if a specific seller issue is involved)
  3. Site (MY / TH / VN / ID / PH / SG)
  4. Request ID (the request_id field in the response body), at least 1
  5. The exact call time (to the second, including time zone)
  6. The complete request parameters and response payload
  7. Reproduction steps / reproduction rate
  8. Expected result vs. actual result

Efficiency tips when submitting a ticket

  1. Focus one ticket on one problem.
  2. Attach screenshots and mark the anomalies.
  3. If you have already ruled out local issues, state what has been ruled out to avoid back-and-forth communication.
